## Summary:

Significantly elevated energetic electron fluxes in the Earth's outer radiation belt. GOES "greater than 2.0 MeV" integral electron flux is above 1000 pfu starting at 2026-08-31T11:20Z. 

The elevated energetic electron flux levels are likely caused by the arrival of one or more of the CMEs with ID 2026-08-25T10:38:00-CME-001 (see notifications 20260825-AL-003, 20260825-AL-006, 20260825-AL-007, 20260825-AL-012), CME with ID 2026-08-25T12:53:00-CME-001 (see notifications 20260825-AL-005, 20260825-AL-007), and/or CME with ID 2026-08-25T14:53:00-CME-001, as well as the arrival of a coronal hole high speed stream which started on 2026-08-28, reaching a maximum speed of approximately 480 km/s. The likely combined arrival of one or more of these CMEs was detected at L1 by SOLAR-1 at 2026-08-28T08:30Z. The solar wind speed observed at L1 is currently around 415 km/s.

NASA spacecraft at GEO, MEO and other orbits passing through or in the vicinity of the Earth's outer radiation belt can be impacted.

Activity ID: 2026-08-31T11:20:00-RBE-001.
